responses.draft_cover_letter:
I’m excited about the opportunity to shape Northpoint Bank’s payments infrastructure. As the lead engineer for an invoicing platform serving 40,000 small businesses, I have guided cross‑functional teams from concept through production, ensuring reliability and scalability.

My core expertise is Python‑centric backend development. I designed and delivered REST APIs with FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL and Redis, processing three million requests daily. Introducing event‑driven payment reconciliation via Redis streams gave the system low‑latency, fault‑tolerant behavior and set the technical direction for the team.

Beyond production code, I maintain an open‑source Python library for parsing bank‑statement CSVs that has attracted 900 GitHub stars, demonstrating practical experience with banking data formats and a commitment to community‑driven quality.

While my professional experience totals five years—short of the eight‑year benchmark—I bring a proven track record of high‑volume systems and am eager to deepen my payments and card‑network knowledge. I have not yet mentored senior engineers or worked directly with PCI DSS compliance, but I am motivated to develop those capabilities and contribute to a culture of continuous learning at Northpoint.
